$comment: Bridge runtime config — checked in. The real .harness/bridge.config.json carries the actual tokens; this example only documents the schema. Keep bridge.config.json out of git.

codex.$comment: Set runtimeSkills=true to advertise v0.3 with runtime skill bundles. Required when the dashboard sends mavis payloads through this bridge.

lucky.$comment: The mavis / Lucky executor. This server is what codex-bridge reverse-proxies mavis calls to.

openclaw.$comment: OpenClaw bridge is exposed via ngrok; not running locally.

routing.$comment: How the dashboard routes each executor family to a public bridge URL.
routing.$comment2: Lucky is routed through codex-bridge as a single public endpoint; the local forwarder hands mavis calls to lucky-mavis-server.
